module.name: WhatsApp
module.label: WhatsApp Integration
module.short_description: Open-Source WhatsApp CRM Integration & Webhook Handler

table.name: vtiger_whatsappmessages
table.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `vtiger_whatsappmessages` ( `whatsappmessageid` INT(19) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, `message_id` VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE, `lead_id` INT(19) NULL, `contact_id` INT(19) NULL, `sender_number` VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, `recipient_number` VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, `direction` ENUM('outgoing', 'incoming') NOT NULL, `message_content` TEXT NOT NULL, `status` ENUM('sent', 'delivered', 'read', 'failed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sent', `failure_reason` VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL, `sent_at` DATETIME NOT NULL, `delivered_at` DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, `read_at` DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, INDEX `idx_msg_id` (`message_id`), INDEX `idx_lead_id` (`lead_id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
